summary: This is a Quarto document configuration that sets up a reveal.js slideshow with a custom CSS theme. It defines the page title and then includes a slide with an image that's sized to 400 pixels wide.

explanations.3: The 'format' key tells Quarto what output format to generate — in this case, revealjs means it will create an interactive HTML slideshow.
explanations.5: This points to a custom CSS file named 'custom.css' that will style how the entire presentation looks instead of using one of Quarto's built-in themes.
explanations.9: The curly braces at the end with 'style=' is Pandoc's attribute syntax that lets you add inline CSS to this specific image, making it exactly 400 pixels wide.
